posts.author: DrFreeman
posts.body:
These were tools I found useful and others that were referred to me. Online collaboration isn't perfect because of network issues of async and sync. But they are far better than doing hours or days of work in silos only to find someone else on your team had already did that. Most of these products are free, but some do have a price.
Art
https://www.canva.com/online-whiteboard/

Articy X
server with multi-user (depends on team size): Dialogue, characters, item concepts, map concepts. It exports to .json, .xml, .docx, .xlsx, and .xlsx.
Bulk Database Editor for RPG Maker MZ (currently: $3.74):
https://bitqueststudio.itch.io/bulk-database-editor
Confluence: Atlassian recently added Live Docs which allows users to collaborate as a team simultaneously. Afterwards, the document can be transferred into a regular page.
BitBucket, Jira, and Confluence are all free.

($10):  For searching
